title: The use of machine learning and deep learning techniques to assess proprioceptive impairments of the upper limb after stroke.
summary: In 429 neuroimaging-confirmed stroke participants and 465 healthy controls, instrumented upper-limb proprioception testing found task impairment in 44% by overall score; ML/DL models classified impairment with mean accuracy 82.4%. This is a specific clinical measurement result, not a rehabilitation-benefit claim.
